collection.title: Citroen C4 Cactus 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C4 Cactus 2014 - 2020 model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 17" on the passengers side with a Bayonet arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have the rear blade for this model, simply click on the Rear Blade Tab below.
